entities.name: Ezuri
entities.description: A Viridian elf, former bandit turned hero who organized resistance to the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Compleated Ezuri
entities.description: Phyrexian-compleated version of Ezuri, a cunning hunter and agent of New Phyrexia who captures his former allies.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Plane invaded and compleated by Phyrexia.

entities.name: Progress Engine
entities.description: Jin-Gitaxias's blue-aligned faction of Phyrexians that compleated Ezuri.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who threatened Ezuri and searched for Karn.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Planeswalker who insisted on finding Karn.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: Rescued by the trio; invited by Ezuri to stay but continued with the companions.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Phyrexian version of Mirrodin whose will Ezuri serves.

entities.name: Tangle
entities.description: Viridian forest dominated and altered by Glissa.

events.summary: Ezuri organizes Viridian elves to fight the Phyrexian invaders and sets up refugee camps for Auriok, Sylvok and Vulshok survivors.
events.quote: He began organizing his fellow Viridian elves into groups that would fight the invaders

events.summary: After Glissa alters the Tangle, Ezuri gathers the remaining elves and Sylvok in the treetops and joins the resistance.
events.quote: He soon led them to join the resistance movement for Mirrodin

events.summary: Ezuri refuses to let Elspeth, Koth and Venser go further, preferring his heroic leadership; Elspeth threatens him and he backs down.
events.quote: When Elspeth threatened Ezuri, however, the elf backed down

events.summary: At Ezuri's camp, Melira refuses to stay behind; Tezzeret's Phyrexians attack the camp as the companions leave.
events.quote: the camp was attacked by Tezzeret 's Phyrexians

events.summary: Ezuri is captured and compleated by the Progress Engine, becoming the Claw of Progress.
events.quote: He eventually was captured and compleated by the Progress Engine

relations.quote: Ezuri became an agent of New Phyrexia's will
He eventually was captured and compleated by the Progress Engine

relations.note: initially obstructed the companions' quest and was threatened by Elspeth
